name: Vitre Appearance
description: Light and dark on a schedule: at sunset and sunrise (from GNOME's location when Location Services is on, else from the time zone) or at times you pick. The wallpaper follows with its light or dark picture. A style you set by hand is kept until the next scheduled switch. Also gives GTK 3 apps the accent colour and the style, which GTK 3 cannot read by itself.
